reason: The target prints cJSON objects, and the source supports an object with a Raw member whose text is printed verbatim. The fixed harness prints only parsed trees, while object parsing cannot create a Raw member. The same blocker exists before and after g0002, so this is preexisting.
finite_witness: Supported setup: create an object, add a Raw member named "x" containing "1e0", then print it. The target can receive bytes 0000{"x":1e0} followed by NUL, but parsing creates a Number member, so that input cannot reach Raw member printing.

scope_contract.reason: Object printing is a target operation. Its source contract accepts object members and delegates their values to the Raw-capable value printer.

evidence.dependency_reason: Defines the supported Raw value rendering.

feasible_trigger.reason: A shallow object with a Raw member is supported through the object constructor and AddRawToObject; the new depth guard permits it. The target's actual tree setup is parsing alone.

evidence.dependency_reason: Provides the supported Raw member setup.
Provides the object for that setup.

observable_consequence.reason: Raw member text is copied verbatim, but the harness never supplies a Raw member to its print calls. For the example spelling 1e0, parsing creates a Number, which is printed from its numeric value.

evidence.dependency_reason: Distinguishes numeric printing from verbatim Raw printing.
Parsing 1e0 stores a Number rather than its original spelling as Raw text.

alternatives_ruled_out.reason: The complete parser value dispatcher has no Raw case, object parsing uses that dispatcher, and the complete harness has no construction or insertion route. An equivalent printed spelling does not reach the Raw member behavior.

evidence.dependency_reason: Complete dispatch of values obtainable by parsing.
Object member values pass through that dispatcher.
Number and Raw values use distinct rendering contracts.

identity_preserved.reason: Both source versions delegate object member printing to the same Raw-capable value printer. The same parse-only harness blocks the same constructed Raw member state on both sides.

evidence.dependency_reason: Before version supports the same Raw rendering.
Before version supports the same Raw member setup.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Before version renders Raw text verbatim.
After version renders Raw text verbatim.

coverage_witness.supported_behavior: Printing an object member of type cJSON_Raw copies its stored text verbatim.
coverage_witness.required_setup: Create a shallow object and add a Raw member, for example cJSON_AddRawToObject(object, "x", "1e0").
coverage_witness.actual_target_setup: The harness obtains its sole print tree from cJSON_ParseWithOpts and performs no member construction or insertion.
coverage_witness.blocked_behavior: The target cannot print a constructed Raw object member.
coverage_witness.equivalent_routes: Parsing creates no Raw value; numeric text such as 1e0 becomes a Number and uses numeric printing. No other harness call constructs a Raw member.
